title: IDT Corporation to Report Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Results
summary: IDT Corporation provides innovative communications and payment services through its Boss Revolution® and net2phone® brands.
body_markdown:
**NEWARK, N.J., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) —**[IDT Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KbJBdFZVvEYs8akcuXTkqkL_MfAD3wxvam6E2Gy-7TrCJQAIxhH5GlJTizFkG5Ti_vSUKF-T10sfRfUDaiTsCw==) (NYSE: IDT), a global provider of fintech and communications solutions, has scheduled its report of financial and operational results for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2026 (the three and twelve months ended July 31, 2026) on Monday, September 28, 2026.


IDT’s earnings release will be issued and posted on the IDT investor relations website ([https://www.idt.net/investors-and–media](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Ke9Ax5U-h2SjmNCSenbaZeo9hX8Ae3g0W2M7NGJmOBUKZURcTGxIQ0lOP7N9SQYi4nAsgIjilBLwljxzWoyaZq4aK_wP6D2d3MWUPsTxJ4FlC-ePbhPq6fYaSm2ieScKK_QVU1djZ9-tKz4cgRT20A==) ) at approximately 4:30 PM Eastern.


IDT will host an earnings conference call beginning at 5:30 PM Eastern with management’s discussion of results followed by Q&A with investors. To listen to the call and participate in the Q&A, dial 1- 888-506-0062 (toll-free from the US) or 1-973-528-0011 (international) and provide the following access code: 266780.


A replay of the conference call will be available approximately three hours after the call concludes through October 12, 2026. To access the call replay, dial 1-877-481-4010 (toll-free from the US) or 1-919-882-2331 (international) and provide this replay passcode: 54497. The replay will also be accessible via streaming audio at the[IDT investor relations website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RrbM-IndZIRdVTR47mMVZJ5HY9DpXzvqaEPxYamcW68wNbDplOKR6HiW5j5G58xi1iX4AqNBd0iR3N8fJPY7MkZuio9Ek0E2jC-2O4PoVgash1RlBE5c7HAjlXeXFzsG) .


**ABOUT IDT CORPORATION**


[IDT Corporation](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KbJBdFZVvEYs8akcuXTkqvS30tIbNRpIHda3avcxXcSO6IkxpuQJ88VBbCe6zrKV-kzDbptpjV40JyOMBx6CwQ==) (NYSE: IDT) is a global provider of fintech, communications and AI-powered customer experience solutions through a portfolio of synergistic businesses:[National Retail Solutions](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HrTcsNZzS1CGE56Mq2B24wMaqJZJHvTunW01e75pjS2GB8BfMwcS2eDugP9fx29daq7Pd_AbyZEmgZx1Jg536mh1QHDhQwJ63ozDvMFVtvY=) ‘ (NRS) point-of-sale (POS) platform enables independent retailers to process transactions and operate more effectively while providing advertisers and marketers with reach into underserved consumer markets;[BOSS Money](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4P606Au8YUymx0mWelhyYJn9-kCWrHeKFqnCBpgwieflx8FQdNDU-FhYwllYDupfiXC_9ib5THoP9kygCZnGdJzpDIeGZ-Uohg2UBlho0WEE4erSGFdNRu4WQ5dowm1_gykbHkSDXi_9lpIkPBD_8g==) facilitates innovative international remittances and fintech payments solutions;[net2phone](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=KyaoJXDk_7_iBuFEDfoSzT2od_OjViedO6fpvqQ0sHttpTgaK8JuozpMiR1t2dYZKbrfdx2EGW6kZh9331z5hg==) provides businesses with AI-driven workflow and communications solutions to enhance customer experience;[BOSS Revolution](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4P606Au8YUymx0mWelhyYIDKYi02vACXwXMtEwtyHzLcid8ZhUwQEJ2syAgj9poO_mcpn4bsuhgcHPAwWxLlezE9yi_CPUDClnH6jHdjTqw=) makes sharing prepaid products and services and speaking with friends and family around the world convenient and reliable; and,[IDT Global](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dujpwAfbY6yzV4EjgOczBb_aqWglG3O3Uc3n_BtwqdHWdLyuYlSuhRvS5xi4rQngMoq9Q-cxumPa09eoPLcwpQ==) and[IDT Express](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7qn5u3p5GTcoChQOOjkIEjg52TtksF7WK75YE4tUUHcb4AmdymgP0nH8e2E0-l0VJDa5-BFCrsDM81Z4CshoTHJS-DHbbzRcW2V_Rcr0plU=) enable communications companies to provision and manage international voice and SMS messaging.
